senses.gloss:
mfn. (-धृत्)
Who has, holds, possesses, &c.
E.
धृ to have, क्विप् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Possessed, held, contained.
2 Cherished, supported.
3 Stood, stayed, standing.
4 Alighted, gone down.
5 Placed.
6 Considered, weighed.
E.
धृ to hold, and क्त aff.

mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु)
Armed with bow and arrow.
E.
धृत, कार्म्मुक a bow, and इषु an arrow.

mfn. (-टः-टा-टं)
Covered or overspread with a cloth, &c.
E.
धृत, and पट a cloth.

m. (-ष्ट्रः)
A proper name; DHṚTARĀṢṬRA, the father of DURYODHANA, and uncle of the Pāṇḍu princes.
2 A good king.
3 A Nāga or serpent of the lower regions.
4 A kind of bird, perhaps a sort of goose: see धार्त्तराष्ट्र.
f. (-री)
A goose, the female bird only.
E.
धृत possessed, cherished, (by whom,) राष्ट्र a region.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
1 Held, was holding.
2 Having taken or conveyed.
E.
धृ to hold, क्तवतु aff.

mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति)
Armed.
E.
धृत, and हेति a weapon.

mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म)
Firm, steady, calm, collected.
E.
धृत, and आत्मन् self.

mfn. (-म्भाः-म्भाः-म्भः)
Full of water.
E.
धृत, and अम्भस् water.

m. (-तिः)
Sacrifice, offering, religious rite or ceremony.
f. (-तिः)
1 Holding, having.
2 Steadiness, firmness.
3 One of the astrological Yogas: see योग.
4 Pleasure.
5 Satisfaction, content.
6 Happiness.
7 A metre; a stanza of four lines of eighteen syllables each.
8 The thirteenth Mātṛkā.
E.
धृ to have, &c. affix क्तिन्.

mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्)
1 Firm, steady, calm.
2 Content.
E.
धृति, and मतुप् aff.

mfn. (मुट्)
Discomposing, agitating.
E.
धृति firmness, and मुष् what steals.

m. (-त्वा)
1 Virtue, morality.
2 A Brahman.
3 The sea.
4 The sky.
5 A clever man.
6 A name of VIṢṆU.
E.
धृ to hold, क्वनिप् affix, तुक् augment.

f. (-री)
The earth.
E.
धृ to hold, क्वरप् affix, and तुक augment.

ind.
Having taken or held.
E.
धृ, and क्त्वा aff.
